questions.content: Discuss the challenges faced by sole proprietorship and suggest solutions for each challenge. (Three (3) points)

questions.answerKey: Limited capital can prevent a large order being filled. Saving part of profits or arranging affordable credit can finance the order. Illness of the owner can interrupt sales.
